documents.unit: Institutional Effectiveness and Grant Development (master syllabi)
documents.title: Artificial Intelligence Syllabus Guidelines & Policies
documents.date_or_term: current (accessed 2026-10-25); syllabus AI-policy requirement effective June 2025
documents.stance_why: The college requires every syllabus to carry an AI policy but sets no single rule: it offers "three options for the use of GAI: Prohibited, Permitted, and Required" and says "faculty will have flexibility", so the document delegates and lists tiers.
documents.summary: A college-wide syllabus framework: every syllabus must carry an AI policy with required elements, and instructors choose prohibited, permitted or required. It also covers detector use, tone toward misuse, privacy, honesty and verification statements, with four sample policies.
